key_provisions_or_claims: No agreed international definition of autonomous weapons systems; the broader US DoD definition should be adopted.
Lack of a binding international legal framework for AI in warfare threatens human rights.
Calls for regulation or a ban on weapons lacking meaningful human control.
The 2016 Joint Declaration on armed drones is vague and criticised as US-led.
An AI arms race among the US, China, Russia and private firms risks destabilising the balance of power.
named_instruments_referenced: Joint Declaration on Export and Use of Armed UAVs 2016
annotation.summary_en: Book chapter arguing that AI-enabled autonomous weapons, especially armed drones, require an international legal framework. It reviews competing AWS definitions, the arms race among major powers, and weaknesses of the 2016 Joint Declaration on armed drones. It urges adoption of the broader US DoD definition and regulation or a ban on weapons without meaningful human control.
annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence, International Law and the Race for Killer Robots in Modern Warfare
